text:
**Member App Launch: Green (to 10 Oct)**

The app is on track for public launch on **18 November**.

- **Beta:** 431 of 600 invited members used it. Average rating was 4.3/5. Members liked the digital card and class booking. The weekend timetable slowness is fixed, with load times under two seconds in testing. Of 23 bugs, 21 are fixed and 2 minor ones will be fixed after launch.
- **Launch plan:** App stores submissions are due 3 November. Club packs go out by 12 November, staff training finishes by 14 November, and posters go up from 17 November. All members get an email on launch day.
- **Budget:** $268.5k spent of $290k. The remainder is expected to come in on budget.
- **Risk:** An app store rejection could delay launch by up to a week. The submission has been checked against both stores' guidelines.

Next update: 24 October.
